notes.v1_10: Handcuffs: Paint the steel as bright, polished chrome with crisp white highlights along the top of each ring and cool blue reflections inside the rings, so the cuffs read clearly darker and brighter than the floor. Make the pink floor slightly richer and more saturated coral, with a soft lighter glow just behind the cuffs. Keep the cuffs, the chain, the locks, the keyholes and the view.
notes.v1_03: Magnifier: Tint the lens glass a pale, clear cool blue-grey in place of the background green, with one soft curved reflection along its upper left. Make the right side of the metal ring and the underside of the red handle slightly darker, and add a soft faint shadow of the magnifier on the rings. Keep the magnifier, the green ring backdrop and the view.
